summary: P3 Health Partners Inc. filed an 8-K on July 6, 2026, reporting a material definitive agreement: the Second Amendment to Repurchase Promissory Note between its wholly owned subsidiary P3 Health Group, LLC and IHC Health Services, Inc. The amendment, dated June 30, 2026, extends the note's maturity to September 30, 2028, and changes interest to 14% PIK accruing from June 30, 2026. No other terms were modified. This is a routine debt amendment, not a special situation. There are no deal terms to monitor, and no risk-arb angle.
